#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

// FastScanner class emulating Java version
class FastScanner {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int pos, len;
    bool eof;
public:
    FastScanner() {
        pos = len = 0;
        eof = false;
    }
    void ensure() {
        if (pos >= len) {
            len = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stdin);
            pos = 0;
            if (len == 0) eof = true;
        }
    }
    char next() {
        while (!eof && (pos >= len || buf[pos] <= ' ')) {
            ensure();
            if (eof) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++];
    }
    int Int() {
        long long res = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        char c = next();
        while (c != -1 && (c < '0' || c > '9')) {
            if (c == '-') sign = -1;
            c = next();
        }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = next();
        }
        return (int)(res * sign);
    }
    long long Long() {
        long long res = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        char c = next();
        while (c != -1 && (c < '0' || c > '9')) {
            if (c == '-') sign = -1;
            c = next();
        }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = next();
        }
        return res * sign;
    }
    string Str() {
        string s;
        char c = next();
        while (c != -1 && c > ' ') {
            s += c;
            c = next();
        }
        return s;
    }
};

// Main class equivalent in C++
class Main {
public:
    static FastScanner fs;
};
FastScanner Main::fs;

// Solution class
class Solution {
public:
    int INF = 2147483647;
    int NINF = -2147483648;
    int MOD = 998244353;
    int mod = 1000000007;
    FastScanner* fs;

    Solution(FastScanner* fs) : fs(fs) {}

    void solution(int all, int testcase) {
        int n = fs->Int();
        mod = fs->Int();

        int maxJ = n * n + 5;
        // dp as 2D vector of long long
        vector<vector<long long>> dp(n, vector<long long>(maxJ, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxJ; j++) {
                for (int cnt = 0; cnt <= i; cnt++) {
                    if (j - cnt >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - cnt];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) {
                            dp[i][j] += mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // sums as prefix sums modulo mod
        vector<vector<long long>> sums(dp.size(), vector<long long>(maxJ, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)dp.size(); i++) {
            long long sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < maxJ; j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                sums[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        // factorial array
        int factSize = 501 * 501;
        vector<long long> fact(factSize, 0);
        fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < factSize; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }

        // ncr array
        int ncrSize = 501;
        vector<vector<long long>> ncr(ncrSize, vector<long long>(ncrSize, 0));
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < ncrSize; i++) {
            ncr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < ncrSize; j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i-1][j] + ncr[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
                if (ncr[i][j] == 0) ncr[i][j] += mod;
            }
        }

        long long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long com = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            if (com == 0) com += mod;
            long long sum = 0;

            vector<long long>& last = dp[cnt - 2];
            long long ssum = 0;
            long long total = 0;
            for (int j = 2; j < maxJ; j++) {
                total += sums[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1);
                total %= mod;
                if (total == 0) total += mod;

                sum += last[j] * total;
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;

                ssum += sums[cnt - 2][j - 2];
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) {
                    ssum -= sums[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1];
                }
                ssum += mod;
                ssum %= mod;
                if (ssum == 0) ssum += mod;

                total -= ssum;
                total += mod;
                total %= mod;
                if (total == 0) total += mod;
            }
            res += sum * com;
            res %= mod;
            if (res == 0) res += mod;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", res % mod);
    }
};

int main() {
    Main::fs = FastScanner();
    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        Solution sol(&Main::fs);
        sol.solution(T, t);
    }
    return 0;
}
